actions.name: Network Resource Access Mediation
actions.description: Control of access to organizational systems and services by users or processes over a network.

actions.name: Access Policy Administration
actions.description: Access policy administration is the systematic process of defining, implementing, and managing access control policies that dictate user permissions to resources.

actions.name: System Call Filtering
actions.description: Controlling access to local computer system resources with kernel-level capabilities.

actions.name: Administrative Network Activity Analysis
actions.description: Detection of unauthorized use of administrative network protocols by analyzing network activity against a baseline.

actions.name: LAN Access Mediation
actions.description: LAN access mediation encompasses the application of strict access control policies, systematic verification of devices, and authentication mechanisms to govern connectivity to a Local Area Network.

actions.name: Implement Security Control during hardware manufacturing
actions.description: Implement strict security controls and auditing processes during the manufacturing phase, including secure supply chain practices and hardware verification methods, to prevent unauthorized modifications to hardware components or firmware.

actions.name: Hardware security modules
actions.description: Conduct thorough risk assessments and enforce usage policies to limit the misuse of hardware functionalities, alongside implementing hardware security modules (HSMs) to ensure only intended uses of hardware features.

actions.name: Principle of least privilege
actions.description: Implement robust access control mechanisms, enforce the principle of least privilege, and regularly update and patch systems to close security gaps that could be exploited for privilege escalation.

actions.name: Utilize integrity controls in hardware
actions.description: Utilize tamper-evident packaging, secure shipping protocols, and block chain-based tracking systems to ensure the integrity of hardware and software during distribution, preventing unauthorized access or modifications.
